story.body: You ran Richard from the rolls and changed nothing from Friday. You told them the comedy was unfinished and not in the room. No one copied a part of it. You were in the play at two.

story.body: You handed over forty-odd leaves after the play. Garnish found the two names and you chose which lady kept which lover. Heminges entered one dull line. Pope asked about the reward and got no part. The license and the seven shillings wait on Friday.
